The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 87b191f75e8c8526), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 62. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let W be a smooth connected projective complex variety of dimension n ≥ 2. Let L, H be rational Cartier divisors, with H ample, let S be an integral Cartier divisor, and fix an integer q > 0 and real numbers r > 1, ϵ > 0. Suppose Hn ≤ (2ϵ)n , KW Hn−1 ≤ 2Hn /r, (2L + qS)Hn−1 ≤ 4Hn , (14ϵ)n < 1 4, 80ϵ < 3 4. (43) Assume that the following fixed data exist. (i) A smooth integral complete-intersection flag from W to a curve C, whose successive divisor classes are hi = liH for fixed positive integers li, with µmin(Ω1 W |C) ≥ 0. (ii) On the projective bundle Z = P OW (S)1 ⊕ OW (S)2  −→ W × W, ξ = c1(OZ(1)), M = L1 + L2 + qξ, use the convention that the direct image of OZ(aξ) is the a-th symmetric power of the displayed sum. A smooth point z∗ in the complement of the two axes and finitely many sections of k0M, for some integer k0 > 0 with k0L Cartier, generate jets through order (2n + 2)k0 at z∗. (iii) A point x ∈ W, its blowup πx : c W → W with exceptional divisor J, and a curve class γ = f∗(A1 · · · An−1), where f : V → c W is one fixed birational morphism, V is smooth integral projective, and the Ai are ample integral Cartier divisors, such that J · γ > 0 and π∗ x(L + KW /2 + λS) · γ ≤ 40ϵJ · γ (0 ≤ λ ≤ q). (44) It suffices to check the two endpoints in this affine inequality. These data cannot coexist.
